changes.before: Wide shot a riverside resident hurrying toward a boat with smoke behind a house, cloudy daylight. Southern England in 1666: working people in plain cloaks, bonnets or bodices; brick or carved wood only on walls or roofs, not contemporary street furniture
changes.after: Medium shot at a Thames landing in 1666: one grey-haired middle-aged man with a lined adult face and broad shoulders, in a dark wool doublet and knee breeches, runs from a smoking plain brick house on the left toward a low wooden rowboat moored at the right; his leading boot steps onto its boarding plank and one hand reaches for the boat side, pale cloudy daylight
